verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cline can run headlessly in CI/CD, auto-commit changes, and operate in isolated git worktrees, but there is no documentation or example showing it ingesting a tracked issue (e.g., GitHub issue) and autonomously producing an opened pull request end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit issue-ingestion workflow, automated PR creation/opening, and any first-party or community example of a full issue→PR pipeline.
